priorWaveOverlapPolicy: Crosswalk all with Batches 1–6, pilot and preexisting Feast Instruction extraction before stating new unique intents. Crosswalk not certified.
numberingHold: Batch 6 unresolved duplicate printed Q950/Q960 is not silently repaired by this subsequent Q968–993 tranche.
policy: No fabricated Catechism Q994 or later. Numbered longer Catechism ends at Q993.
Feast Instruction uses editorial per-chapter ordinal locators, clearly separate from original global printed questions.
All new EN/FR answers are educational documentary paraphrases, not verified sentence-level translations nor Pius X authenticated personal utterances.
Historical feasts, fasting, devotional habits and 1905 obligations must not be represented as timeless current law.
Moral and confessional discussion must not diagnose culpability or encourage compulsive self-examination.
Do not duplicate upstream Feast Instruction source extraction; this is adapted conversation layer only.
All release flags false; no router, sprites or production edits.
